item.title: Keeping a garden log through the seasons
item.description: A garden log is a notebook of what was planted, where and when. Ours started as a list of seed packets and grew into a record of frosts, harvests and the beds that never dry out. It doesn't need to be tidy. This invented description runs past three hundred characters so the summary is cut at its limit and the full text stays in the content.
